verdict.rationale: Unleash documents some multi-item capabilities. Feature flags can be exported and imported, and change requests let you group several changes and apply them together at a set time. This is narrower than general bulk operations; segments reused across many flags are only adjacent support. Missing for 10: documented bulk actions on selected flags (e.g., bulk enable/disable/archive/tag), bulk Admin API or MCP endpoints for AI-driven batch changes, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Export/import feature flags for easy migration
Change requests also allow you to group changes and apply them at a specific point in time.
